# Zorga

Zorga is a strategic platform architecture company based in the United Arab Emirates. Website: https://zorga.co

## What Zorga does

Zorga develops the idea, stakeholder structure, commercial model and route to market behind industry platforms, before execution begins. An event may be one output; the architecture behind the platform is the core work.

## How Zorga works

- Originate: create a platform from an opportunity
- Co-create: build around a shared objective with an institution, company or industry body
- Architect: rethink an existing platform
- Partner: bring a Zorga concept to market with specialist partners

## Selected concepts

- IDGS (India Defence Growth Summit) - India / defence - status: in development
- RevX (Revenue Architecture Forum) - GCC / revenue - status: platform concept developed - https://zorga.co/concepts/revx
- AI-WAQF (AI-WAQF Summit) - Islamic finance / technology - status: platform concept developed - https://zorga.co/concepts/ai-waqf
- SourceScape (Hospitality Sourcing Experience) - hospitality / sourcing - status: platform concept developed - https://zorga.co/concepts/sourcescape

No concept listed here is presented as an executed event unless its status says so.
